newsitem.title: USA: Arris, Abbott in technology pact.
newsitem.headline: Arris, Abbott in technology pact.

text.p: Arris Pharmaceutical Corp on Wednesday said it entered a collaboration with Abbott Laboratories Inc involving the transfer of certain drug discovery technologies to Abbott.
Arris said Abbott would use the technology in undisclosed proprietary research programs.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed, but Arris said the pact provided for a license fee and royalties due after the commercialization of products resulting from use of the technology.
Arris has also retained certain rights to transfer the technologies to other pharmaceutical companies.
Arris is a drug-development company focusing on discovering the structure of disease-causing enzymes or proteases so it can develop inhibitors that bind to them.
